gaps.cross_case_relevance: Any case-local program can intentionally return a nonzero exit after writing structured diagnostic output; such evidence must remain sealable.
first_run_evidence: Five frozen nonzero-exit captures contain structured output and failure=null.
All five were rejected by seal-run with RC_MANIFEST_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE_INCONSISTENT.
gaps.proposed_change: Make the controlled executor attach RC_EXECUTION_NONZERO_EXIT to every nonzero exit when no more specific failure exists, whether or not output.json already exists.
gaps.reference_evidence: NONE_ACCESSED; not needed to establish the executor invariant.
gaps.risk_of_overfitting: LOW; the test uses a generic program, neutral candidate names, and no case data, constants, equations, or conclusions.
gaps.root_cause: The executor assigned a fallback failure only when output.json was absent, leaving a failed capture internally inconsistent when the child wrote diagnostics before exiting nonzero.
gaps.verification_test: A generic case-local program writes a valid diagnostic output and exits 2; execute records FAILED plus RC_EXECUTION_NONZERO_EXIT, and seal-run accepts the failed manifest.

gaps.cross_case_relevance: A first-run can correctly freeze one immutable Skill commit while executing case code introduced by a later worktree commit.
first_run_evidence: Execution manifests bound case code at f683ce76ff086b7109571e5124fb8a8218377725.
The original freeze check incorrectly required both values to be identical.
gaps.proposed_change: Retain the already tested repository freeze-tool correction that validates the frozen Skill blob at the Skill commit separately from execution code at its manifest commit.
gaps.rejection_reason: The defect is in project evaluation infrastructure, not in the formal Skill runtime, and was repaired before the immutable first-run freeze without altering Skill code or Run evidence.
gaps.risk_of_overfitting: LOW; commit-role separation is case independent.
gaps.root_cause: The freeze tool conflated the immutable Skill provenance commit with the later case-code provenance commit.
gaps.verification_test: Freeze succeeds when Skill and case code bind different valid commits, and fails when either referenced blob hash is wrong.

gaps.cross_case_relevance: Mechanistic models generally need boundary-condition and calibration validation, but the observed miss is tied to this case implementation and its environmental-profile approximation.
first_run_evidence: No candidate passed all four requirements.
Frozen validation RMSE values were 63.16751794, 20.144894, and 48.37396765 degrees Celsius for the surviving candidate outputs.
The first-run scientific-validity record identifies cooling-validation error and a linear zone-center environmental profile as limitations.
gaps.proposed_change: Improve only the case-owned model after unlock; retain general initial/boundary, identifiability, residual, convergence, and feasibility gates already present in the Skill.
gaps.reference_evidence: NONE_ACCESSED; failure is directly observable from frozen measurements and constraints.
gaps.rejection_reason: A formal Skill change would need case-specific physics or parameters and would duplicate existing generic checks.
gaps.risk_of_overfitting: HIGH if transferred into the Skill.
gaps.root_cause: The selected environmental boundary approximation and fitted low-order dynamics did not reproduce the observed cooling regime or yield a fully feasible constrained solution.
gaps.verification_test: Development-only regression must independently recompute all process constraints, report calibration residuals, and reject any infeasible Final.

gaps.cross_case_relevance: Empty feasible sets should be handled explicitly, but this exception arose in case-owned search code rather than the generic state machine.
first_run_evidence: RUN-PRIMARY-TWO-NODE-20260904 raised ValueError: min() arg is an empty sequence.
The exception followed an empty symmetry-candidate pool after refinement.
gaps.proposed_change: Repair the case-owned optimizer to emit an explicit infeasible result and never reduce an empty candidate collection.
gaps.reference_evidence: NONE_ACCESSED; traceback and capture are sufficient.
gaps.rejection_reason: The formal Skill already requires feasibility checks and failed-Run preservation; the missing guard is local implementation code.
gaps.risk_of_overfitting: MEDIUM if encoded as a case-shaped Skill branch.
gaps.root_cause: Case-owned direct search assumed a nonempty feasible refinement pool before computing its minimum.
gaps.verification_test: An empty feasible pool yields structured INFEASIBLE evidence, a nonzero captured Run, and a sealable failed manifest without an unhandled exception.
